claimText:
Replace the "Inspire the Work" video in `ai-course-building-resources` with the provided `Autonomy_in_Assessment__Validating_the_Process.mp4`, redeploy the Google Hosted presentation, and collect fresh STAX proof for the live `digitalpresentation` site.

Goal:
- Update only the canonical media source for the Inspire the Work section.
- Regenerate the Google Hosted export for `ai-course-building-resources`.
- Redeploy only the `digitalpresentation` Firebase Hosting target.
- Verify the live site and the live video asset after deploy.

Acceptance boundary:
- Do not edit `raw/**`.
- Do not modify unrelated projects or shared deploy code.
- Do not revert unrelated working-tree changes.

STAX acknowledgement
STAX_ACK turn_2026-06-02T20-26-52-990Z_b8b0 30607941 9597d9de

Objective
Redeploy the Firebase Google Hosted versions for the courses changed for locked-content blur behavior: `forensicstudiesoption2-nextstep-test`, `learning-strategies-15`, `learning-strategies-25`, and `learning-strategies-35`.

Files changed
- Generated Google Hosted exports under `projects/forensicstudiesoption2-nextstep-test/exports/google-hosted/`, `projects/learning-strategies-15/exports/google-hosted/`, `projects/learning-strategies-25/exports/google-hosted/`, and `projects/learning-strategies-35/exports/google-hosted/`.
- Export approval/deviation metadata updated by export preflight in each of the four project `meta/` folders.
- No raw project files were edited in this deploy pass.

Tests added
None in this deploy pass.

Commands run
- `Get-Content .stax/turn-contract.json` - exit 0.
- `Get-Content .stax/status.json` - exit 0.
- `Get-Content .stax/next-codex-prompt.md` - exit 0.
- `Get-Content docs/ops/FAST_PATHS.md` - exit 0.
- `npm run export:google-hosted -- --project forensicstudiesoption2-nextstep-test` - exit 0.
- `npm run export:google-hosted -- --project learning-strategies-15` - exit 0.
- `npm run export:google-hosted -- --project learning-strategies-25` - exit 0.
- `npm run export:google-hosted -- --project learning-strategies-35` - exit 0.
- `firebase --version` - exit 0, version 15.9.1.
- `node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --test scripts/tests/google-hosted-deploy.test.ts scripts/tests/google-hosted-export.test.ts` - exit 0.
- `npm run deploy:google-hosted -- --project forensicstudiesoption2-nextstep-test,learning-strategies-15,learning-strategies-25,learning-strategies-35` - exit 0.
- Live fetch verification for `https://forensics25.web.app`, `https://learningstrategies15.web.app`, `https://learningstrategies25.web.app`, and `https://learningstrategies35.web.app` - exit 0.
- `npm run stax:preflight -- --repo C:\Users\dean.guedo\Documents\GitHub\canvas-helper --mode observer --boundary deploy` - exit 0, observer verdict Reject.

Command output summary with exit codes
- Four Google Hosted exports completed: Forensics Next Step 385 files, Learning Strategies 15 82 files, Learning Strategies 25 88 files, Learning Strategies 35 78 files.
- Firebase CLI was available as version 15.9.1.
- Google Hosted deploy/export tests passed: 28/28 tests passed.
- Firebase deploy completed for all requested projects and reported `Google Hosted deploy complete.`
- Live verification returned HTTP 200 for all four root pages and confirmed `google-hosted-bridge.js`, root locked-card blur CSS, chapter `../module-index.css` links, and module-index `filter: blur(2px)` rules on all four live sites.
- STAX observer preflight returned exit 0 but verdict Reject because the sidecar task remains tied to an older unrelated `ai-course-building-resources` task and initially disliked report section formatting.

What is verified
- Firebase hosting deploy completed for `forensics25`, `learningstrategies15`, `learningstrategies25`, and `learningstrategies35`.
- The live deployed root pages include the Google Hosted bridge.
- The live deployed CSS includes `.locked-card > :not(.status-chip)` and `filter: blur(2px)`.
- The live deployed chapter 1 pages include `../module-index.css`.
- The live deployed module CSS includes `filter: blur(2px)`.

What is weak/provisional
- The STAX sidecar status and `.stax/task.md` still reference an older unrelated `ai-course-building-resources`/`digitalpresentation` task, so sidecar verdicts may not match this Firebase redeploy task.
- A standalone Playwright visible-selector check against chapter pages timed out because `.locked-card` was not visible on that standalone route; the live asset/content verification passed.

What is unverified
- I did not complete a live end-to-end browser pass through every locked learner card on every deployed course.
- I did not update the stale `.stax/task.md` because it was not blank under the repo protocol.

Risks
- Firebase CDN/browser cache may briefly show an older asset in already-open browser tabs until refresh.
- Forensics Next Step did not have its own stored Firebase config in `meta/`; the generated export reused the existing Forensics 25 Firebase app config from the original Forensics hosted export, with `projectSlug` changed to `forensicstudiesoption2-nextstep-test`.

One next action
Open the four live URLs in a fresh/private browser tab and hard refresh if an old cached page is still visible.
